name: Tally
description: Self-hosted personal finance for households. Track accounts, transactions, budgets, savings goals, and debt. Link transactions to savings goals and debts. Record transfers between accounts. CSV and PDF bank statement import with reconciliation. AI chat interface (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama). One-click backup, full JSON export, and CSV export from Settings, plus an automatic verified snapshot before any upgrade that changes the database. Dracula theme. Single Docker container. Runs as a non-root user; the appdata data path must remain writable by the container (default on Unraid). Single-tenant design: any authenticated user (owner or viewer) can see all financial data — roles limit actions, not data visibility. Do not expose to untrusted users or the public internet. If you reach Tally through a reverse proxy, tunnel, or custom domain, set ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

paths.name: Data Volume
paths.description: SQLite database storage. Must be a persistent path on the host. The container runs as a non-root user, so this path must be writable by the container (the default /mnt/user/appdata location on Unraid already is). Tally fails to create its database on first start if it is not writable.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port Tally is reached on. Access the app at http://[serverIP]:[this port]. Tally listens on 8091 inside the container; only change the host side unless you know why.

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: JWT signing key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of browser origins permitted to call the app (CORS). Leave blank to allow only the local origin. If you reach Tally through a reverse proxy, tunnel, or custom domain/hostname, you MUST list that origin here or the browser app will break. Example: https://tally.example.com,https://tally.example.duckdns.org

variables.name: MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum size in bytes for an uploaded bank statement file (CSV/PDF). Default 10485760 (10 MB). Increase only if you import unusually large statements.

variables.name: FIRST_RUN_OWNER_USERNAME
variables.description: Auto-creates the first owner account on startup. Leave blank to use the setup page instead.

variables.name: RECOVERY_TOKEN
variables.description: Emergency owner password reset token. Set to any strong random value (openssl rand -hex 32), call POST /api/auth/recover, then remove this variable and restart. Leave blank when not in use.

variables.name: BACKUP_DIR
variables.description: Directory where automatic pre-upgrade database snapshots are written. Leave blank to use a backups folder beside the database — /data/backups with the shipped Data Volume path.

variables.name: BACKUP_KEEP
variables.description: How many automatic pre-upgrade snapshots to keep. Older snapshots are deleted after a new one is written. Minimum 1.

variables.name: PRE_MIGRATION_BACKUP
variables.description: Set to off to skip the automatic verified snapshot Tally takes before an upgrade changes the database. Leave on unless you run your own backup process and want faster upgrades.

variables.name: AI_PROVIDER
variables.description: AI provider for the chat feature: anthropic, openai, or ollama (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). AI is entirely optional — the rest of Tally works fully without it, and with no API key set no request is ever made. Note that clearing this field does NOT turn the feature off and does NOT hide the AI Coach page: the page stays visible in the sidebar and opens normally, but shows an error if you try to send a message without an API key. Leave this set to a real provider name; control whether AI is active with AI_API_KEY.

variables.name: AI_API_KEY
variables.description: API key for the selected AI provider. Not required for local Ollama.

variables.name: AI_MODEL
variables.description: Model name to use (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o, llama3). Defaults to provider default if left blank.

variables.name: AI_BASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. http://ollama:11434/v1). Required for Ollama; leave blank for Anthropic or OpenAI.

variables.name: CHAT_HISTORY_TURNS
variables.description: How many prior chat turns are replayed as context in the AI Coach. Defaults to 30 for hosted providers (Anthropic/OpenAI) or 10 for Ollama. Does not limit what is stored — the full conversation is always kept in the database.

variables.name: TALLY_LOCAL_PROVIDER_WRITE_TOOLS
variables.description: Only applies when AI_PROVIDER=ollama. Set to allow to let a local model use write tools; the default (deny) strips them.
